author: Erin Conahan
quote: It fits perfectly under the seat without having to lay down and slides effortlessly on the luggage handle.
paraphrase: Tote fits under plane seat and slides on luggage handle.

author: Lorraine Speirs
quote: Recent train trip from Scotland to Oxford was made so much easier with this tote rather than my backpack.
paraphrase: Tote more convenient than backpack for train journey.

author: Mary Toms
quote: I purchased a NORDACE travel tote including accessories at a cost of £150.
paraphrase: Parcel misdelivered; raised rating after replacement.

author: Eileen Lowe
quote: So many different sections for separating your belongings making it so much easier to find things.
paraphrase: Aqua Sienna tote compartments keep things organized.

author: Ieuan Wickham
quote: The bag that was delivered had very poor quality stitching, with long loose threads on the handle.
paraphrase: Siena Pro tote sloppy stitching; replacement similar.

author: Suzanne
quote: I can genuinely say this is the best quality Tote type bag I have ever had.
paraphrase: Hesitant to buy online at high price; best-made tote owned.

author: Linda
quote: I couldn’t put my iPad in it.
paraphrase: Bag too small for iPad; needed larger bag for trip.

author: Kellie
quote: the bag was really small, feels like plastic and delivery times were much longer than I realised
paraphrase: Laptop bag small, cheap-feeling, slow delivery; accepted 30% refund.

author: Jean Kramarik
quote: Worked beautifully on my last trip.
paraphrase: Siena Pro tote matched description, performed well.

author: Lisa Hauser
quote: I was disappointed that the two didn't match.
paraphrase: Mismatched colors; replacement tote and kept first.

author: Janie
quote: Very roomy for travel purposes and also for day to day work.
paraphrase: Siena Grande tote spacious for travel and work.
